_about: Player-type tags from karma's reads (21 Nov 2026), display only. See the project doc claude/archetype-matchup-idea-2026-11-21.md. 'rim runner' = REB is the bet, PTS volatile; 'bag big' = has his own post/face-up/shooting, PTS is the bet; 'tall skilled big' = 7'+ with a bag, edge vs small or weak-rim bigs; 'physical forward' = edge vs OKC-style small switching defences; 'downhill creator' = young handler/attacker, edge vs OKC. Add tags as karma calls them or the play-by-play tagging backtest confirms them. 'active' = forces his shots whatever the matchup (karma 21 Nov on Fears: 'plays fearlessly like he's the franchise star'), so shot volume holds vs tough defences; efficiency may not. Use FGA/PRA/low PTS rungs, and still check blowout minutes. 'driver' = lives on drives (karma 21 Nov on Fears: 'he drives alot'); vs an elite rim protector the drives turn into kick-out assists rather than points (Fears draws only 2.9 FTA, 5.4 AST in 2026-27). 'ball-dominant iso' = slows the offence into isolations; when he sits, pace and ball movement go up (karma 21 Nov: Brown out → PHI faster). 'pace facilitator' = needs pace, cutters and slips to pass to; capped next to a ball-dominant iso star (karma: 'another reason it didnt really work with luka'). 'steps up when handler sits' = usage jumps when the main ball-handler is out (Edgecombe 2025-26 with Maxey out: 21.7 pts, 15+ in 9/11). Rule (21 Nov): when a ball-dominant iso player sits, check who the next handler is — if he is iso-heavy too (Reaves for Luka: 43 pts on 27 FGA, 8 Nov @DET), the usage goes to him and the pace does not change; if he is a pace facilitator (LeBron for Brown), the pace goes up and cutters/young wings benefit. OKC hub chain (karma 21 Nov): SGA sits → Hartenstein is the hub; SGA and Hartenstein both sit → Jaylin Williams is the hub (2024-25: 11.3/9.2/6.2 in 26 min, 3 triple-doubles in 6 games; 2025-26: 16.6/9.4/4.2 in 30 min). With only Hartenstein out (SGA plays) Jaylin barely changes (8.5/5.2/2.2; 7.0/6.4/2.5), because SGA keeps the ball. 'shifty guard' = small/quick handler who changes direction (SGA, Acuff, Garland); karma 21-22 Nov: big/tall or switch-heavy defences (BOS, DAL) struggle with them even when their position-level numbers look neutral — the box tool's guard/wing/big buckets miss this.
Austin Reaves: next handler (takes usage when Luka sits)
Jaylin Williams: hub when SGA and Hartenstein both sit
Brayden Burries: MIL second option / closes games (karma 21 Nov: 21 pts, 4 ast, on floor in clutch vs PHI; line was 11.5)
